name: CWA Maximum Impact, 27 July 2003

date.source: the page's own heading, Maximum Impact July 27, 2003

matches.note: Shannon slingshots Dan Field off the top rope into a cradle for the three.
Caveman pins Storm among the ruins of a table after a back body drop sends Storm through it.
Wren wins with a piledriver off the ropes.
Spikey Tiger runs in and hits Apocolyptica with a chair; the commentary gives Apocolyptica the win by disqualification.
Katt hits Lickety Split with a bag of quarters and gets the pin.
Harmony Fallacia pins Nick Vinyard in her first CWA match.
PB FUBU wins with a CN Tower Bomb off the top rope.
Freak pins Ingee Shmelky for a count of about fifty; Adam West then produces Shengee Shmelky from under his cape and Freak rolls him up for a three count.
Dex Cooper is hurt when Lone Wolf throws him out onto Rex and the referee calls for the bell; the commentary gives the win to Moose and Lone Wolf.

Sinners Inc. jump Romeo and 6Pac before the bell, Asmodeus is about to choke slam 6Pac when the fake CellBlock music distracts him, and 6Pac low blows him; the referee spots it and declares the match over with Sinners Inc. the winners.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-superior
matches.note: Q retains: the referee stops the match after a Q Jumper drops Cyrus to the arena floor; a masked man then attacks Q.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-world-tag
matches.note: Jakob hits Hitoni with a piece of the broken table; the win goes to Shelia Lavin and Hitoni Kiashi by disqualification and BOD keep the belts.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-world
matches.note: Dizz retains after a second Reckless Abandon.

notes: A pay-per-view card of thirteen matches closing with Dizz keeping the World title over Leech after both men hit several finishers, and Q keeping the Superior title over Cyrus. After Shannon Skanes's win a man lowers himself from the rafters into the smoke and Shannon is taken away by ambulance in a neck brace; Vesuvius goes looking for the man. The page's closing line looks to the next month's Animosity. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Animosity, 24 August 2003

date.source: the page prints no date; its own title history dates the World, Women's and tag-title changes the card shows to 24 August 2003 and the previous card closes by looking to Animosity

matches.note: Harmony Fallacia rolls Demetra up after a baton shot and the injured referee counts the three.
Apocolyptica wins with a running power slam and the EMTs take Scavenger out on a stretcher.
The match is overtaken by a double-cross: Damien and Shannon beat Max down, Kindred then sides with Damien and the two leave Shannon bleeding; no finish is called.

Puppet Master tells the ring that Cerberus (concussed) and Lone Wolf (beaten backstage by Nightmare) cannot make it and that Nightmare and he are the winners by forfeit; Damien and Kindred then come down and the four fight on the ramp and at ringside, where a table spot ends with Damien and Kindred knocked out by someone in the dark.
6Pac Dudley chairs the referee and Venom; Mini Sal pins Venom and Troy Strong, in a referee's shirt, makes the count. The page's header bills the third man as Pyro; its text names Raptor.
Spikey Tiger wins with the Eye of the Tiger, a chokeslam power bomb.
VP Dave comes out, awards the match to Katt by disqualification and suspends Cyrus.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-womens
matches.note: Scarlet Bitch wins with the Bitch Slam and is the new Women's champion.
Pyro wins with a handful of tights while Caveman protests to the referee; the winner is promised an Aerial title shot the next week.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-world-tag
matches.note: Ezra refuses to break an Indian Deathlock; Numero Uno calls for the bell and BOD are disqualified, Northern Exposure keep the belts.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-aerial
matches.note: Celia chairs Wren and 6Pac, Venom power bombs 6Pac, and the referee throws the match out after Celia's pin.
BasketKase wins with a powerbomb into the exposed turnbuckle and a foot on her chest.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-superior
matches.note: Shelia Lavin helps Q with a chair and brass knuckles, a guest referee billed as Bret Hart takes over after she power bombs the regular referee, and he calls for the bell after Q drives a crow bar into Asmodeus's ribs from the top rope; Q keeps the belt.

matches.stipulation: King/Queen of the Pay Per View, thirteen entrants (eight men and five women) entering one at a time in the order listed and eliminated by pinfall or count-out, Romeo Salvador refereeing
matches.note: Eliminations in order: Venom (counted out by Romeo, who first rules no count-outs and then says they apply), Apocolyptica (pinned by BasketKase), Max Cameron (rolled up by BasketKase), Spikey Tiger (pinned by BasketKase), Puppet Master (rolled up by Nacho Mauma), Nacho Mauma (pinned by Nightmare), Ophelia (declared counted out after Chastity pulls her from the ring), Nightmare (pinned by Wren after a double chair shot from Damien and Kindred), Wren SilverPhoenix (pinned by BasketKase), Hitoni Kiashi (pinned by Scarlet Bitch with the Bitch Slam) and BasketKase (rolled up by Scarlet after Romeo chin-kicks him). In the last pair Demona Calaway wins with the Darkness Surrounding on Scarlet Bitch, BasketKase making the unconscious Romeo's hand slap the mat for the three, and is the Queen of the PPV; Scarlet then attacks her and breaks the trophy.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-world
matches.note: Dizz pins Leech after Reckless Abandon and a corkscrew moonsault with his feet on the ropes unseen by the referee, and takes the title from The Moose.

notes: A pay-per-view built on a thirteen-entrant King/Queen of the Pay Per View match and a three-way for the World title. Scarlet Bitch wins the Women's title from Lickety Split, Demona Calaway wins the King/Queen match, and Dizz takes the World title from The Moose in the three-way. Damien and Kindred turn on Shannon Skanes and Max Cameron in the opening tag match; Nightmare and Puppet Master of Total Darkness are then declared winners by forfeit over Cerberus and Lone Wolf and fight Damien and Kindred on the ramp. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

Shannon Skanes keeps the Superior title when the referee stops his match with Nightmare, a cage match between Pyro and Max Cameron is broken up by Adin Vick, Venom and Demetra, and Angela wins the four-way Queen of the Pay Per View. name: CWA Dead By Dawn, 20 October 2003

matches.note: Eliminations in order: Regina (Kristen Burren), Ophelia (Cordelia Stryker), Robyn Connor (Cordelia), Chastity (Kristen) and finally Kristen Burren, whose pants Cordelia pulls off; the bell sounds and the Mafia Girls win control of Dave Morbid's shares. Cordelia then chokes Kristen with her bra straps until Kathy Smith runs in, and the rest of the finish is cut from the page by its own censor notice.
Both fight with the ring bell and the referee calls the match a no contest after Annalyse hits Hitoni with it.
Dante hits Samuel Amos with brass knuckles out of the referee's sight, then pins Vesuvius for the three.
Tasha Calaway wins with a hurricanrana off the top rope.
Cordelia Stryker hits Samantha Johnson with a crow bar before the bell; after a double clothesline Samantha does not get up and the referee calls for the bell.
Ash wins with the Final Fade off the top rope.

matches.stipulation: King of the Pay Per View

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-womens
matches.note: Demona Calaway retains with the Darkness Surrounding; Annalyse and Demona are chaired by Samantha Johnson afterwards.

matches.stipulation: Hardcore Hell for the vacant Hardcore title, eight entrants coming in one at a time in the order listed and eliminated by pinfall
matches.title: cwa-association-2003-hardcore
matches.note: Eliminations in order: Earnest Harris (pinned by Spikey Tiger), Caveman (Steve Hawkins trips Spikey Tiger, who is carrying Caveman; Caveman lands on him and holds him down for a three that the page counts as Caveman's elimination), Steve Hawkins (pinned by Spikey Tiger), Spikey Tiger (pinned by Pyro through a table), Pyro (rolled up by Max Cameron). Max Cameron then throws 6Pac Dudley through two tables, drops Shelia Lavin on him, wins with a five-star frog splash at ringside and pins both for the three; he is the new Hardcore champion.

matches.stipulation: Dead By Dawn four-way in an octagon for the World title, fought tag-style with two men in the ring and the others tagging in from outside; Kindred is billed as the referee but never appears
matches.title: cwa-association-2003-world
matches.note: Eliminations in order: The Moose (pinned by Q after a Doomsday Device from the octagon wall with Shannon Skanes holding him), Q (pinned by Vigilante after his head hits the steel crossbar) and Vigilante (rolled up by Shannon Skanes after a spine buster). Shannon Skanes is the winner and Tony Parizi carries off the belt.

notes: The Halloween pay-per-view. Shannon Skanes wins the four-way Dead By Dawn octagon match for the World title, Max Cameron wins Hardcore Hell for the Hardcore title, Demona Calaway keeps the Women's title over Angela, and the Mafia Girls win a three-team bra-and-panty match for control of Dave Morbid's shares. Lunacy Muse appears afterwards with the World and Superior belts. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Backdraft, 1 December 2003

date.source: the page's own heading, Backdraft December 1, 2003

matches.note: Pyro wins with a knee drop and a choke as the referee reaches for the call.
Giovanni Mabius wins after rolling Storm back in before the ten count.
Frank Merritt wins the match.

The stakes are a dating game for Baby on Breakthrough if she wins and a date for Romeo on Assault if he does. Romeo hands her roses, which make her sneeze, and tries not to hurt her; he knocks her off the top rope by accident, she lands face down on the floor, the referee calls for the bell at once and Lacy Brown announces Romeo the winner.
Angel turns Shelia Lavin's dive into a power bomb on the floor and the referee reaches a ten count; the match is a draw.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-superior
matches.note: Vigilante retains the Superior title.
Dante wins, in small part due to Lunacy Muse's involvement.
Cleo Styles hits Angela with brass knuckles and pins her.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-world-tag
matches.note: Eliminations in order: Giovanni Mabius (pinned by Dos), Jammer (pinned by Jon Shocker), PB FUBU (rolled up by Dos), Black Panther (pinned by Marcus Cameron, his partner Jon Shocker staying in), Max Cameron (pinned by Dos), Slammin' Jammin' Inc (Slammer pinned by Shocker with the Last Ride), Adin Vick (rolled up by Lightning, which eliminates Mabius and Vick as a team), Los Especialistos (Dos submits to Lightning's Indian Deathlock) and Marcus Cameron (pinned by Lightning with the Shock Wave, which eliminates the Camerons). Jon Shocker then pins Lightning with the Time Bomb; Dark Forces (Jon Shocker and Black Panther, with Amy Chase) are the new World Tag champions.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-hardcore
matches.note: Max Cameron keeps the Hardcore title: after a table explodes in a ball of fire he puts an arm over Moose and the referee counts the three.

matches.note: Eliminations in order: Scavenger (lifted over the top by Fallout), Ebony (knocked out by Pyro), Marcus Cameron (thrown out by Fallout), Spikey Tiger (Fallout pulls down the top rope), Casanova (Fallout), Gothic Angel (Tiffany), Fallout (Pyro's superkick), Baby Calaway (6Pac's superkick, meant for Max Cameron, lands on her), 6Pac Dudley (Pyro and Max Cameron) and Pyro (Tiffany). matches.title: cwa-association-2003-world
matches.note: Q pins Ash with Dizz underneath for leverage after a Q-Jumper and is the new World champion.

matches.note: Eliminations in order: Lightning (pinned by Adin Vick), Adin Vick (Slammer and Jammer's Slam N Jam camel clutch, called unconscious), Slammer (pinned by Giovanni Mabius after Pyro's 450 splash), Jammer (Max Cameron's Texas Clover Leaf), PB FUBU (pinned by Wren SilverPhoenix, 6Pac too late), Pyro (pinned by 6Pac Dudley), Spikey Tiger (pinned by Wren), Twisted (pinned by Mabius with The Hit), Giovanni Mabius (Wren's Phoenixity), Wren SilverPhoenix (pinned by Max Cameron) and 6Pac Dudley (pinned by Max Cameron with a DDT). Max Cameron is the last man for Youthful Aggression; he has been in four matches that night.

notes: The November-December pay-per-view, opened by Pyro's win over Damien and closed by a Hell in a Cell main event in which Q takes the World title from Dizz. Dark Forces win the World Tag titles in a six-team match, Max Cameron keeps the Hardcore title in a three-way, Tiffany wins the twelve-entrant King/Queen of the Pay Per View match and Youthful Aggression wins a twelve-man three-team elimination main event. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

notes: The Russian pay-per-view. Ash wins the World title in a three-way, Tommy Air wins the Superior title in a three-way, Dark Forces keep the tag titles over Tommy Air and Halloween Jack and Chastity wins the King/Queen of the Pay Per View match over Notorious BLC. Gothic Angel disappears from Pyro's locker room. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Assault, 31 May 2004

date.source: the page's own heading, Assault May 31, 2004

matches.note: Bleach wins his debut with a lionsault over a knocked-out Sandman.

matches.stipulation: cage match, BLC starting the fight before the cage is lowered
matches.note: Sandman slams the door into Frank's face as he leaves, reaches in and unties BLC's boot, BLC slips out of it and falls to the floor as the winner, and Sandman then gets into the cage and fights Frank Merritt.
Shelia Lavin hits Angela with a chair and the referee calls for the bell; no winner is named.
Gothic Angel taps out to Wish's hold; Wish keeps it on and Pyro runs in with a chair.
Vesuvius clubs Angelo with a chair and the referee, finding him not moving, calls for the bell; Vesuvius wins by superior decision.
Pyro wins with a power slam and the tights hooked.
Harmony puts Lethal Weapon in a camel clutch before he bucks her off and wins with the Golden Bullet Spear; Angela then chairs him twice.

matches.stipulation: next week's number-one contender match for the Superior title
matches.note: Lone Star wins with the Falling Star from the top rope in an upset; Viper's interference is stopped by a short-arm clothesline.
Ash wins with the Pipe Cashing while Tommy Air watches Frank Merritt power bomb Shelia Lavin on the ramp; Tommy's Superior title is not billed as on the line.

notes: The Assault with Sunstroke coming. Notorious BLC escapes a cage to beat Frank Merritt while Sandman brawls with Frank, and Vesuvius wins by the referee's decision over Gerard Angelo. KillSwitch, after Pyro's match with Marcus Cameron, announces a group called Humanity Crisis and presents Gothic Angel as its newest member; that and the Flock's attack on the Glamour Girls at the end are not matches. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Assault, 7 June 2004

date.source: the page's own heading, Assault June 7, 2004

matches.note: Gothic Angel, with KillSwitch at ringside, rolls Micheal Leary up with a handful of tights while he argues with KillSwitch.
Angelo body slams Marcus on the floor and rolls back in while the referee reaches ten; the fans boo the count-out win.
The referee counts both men out as the fight spills outside.
Pyro wins with the Burnout; the lights go out and KillSwitch is standing over him afterwards.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-superior
matches.note: Tommy Air sidesteps Lone Star's charge into the corner, rolls him up for the three and keeps the Superior title; Ash and Shannon Skanes then chair and piledrive Lone Star and Shannon fires him.
Angela rolls Weapon up for three but the replay shows both sets of shoulders down and the result is declared a draw.

matches.title: cwa-association-2003-world
matches.note: Ash retains the title with a Pipe Cashing.

notes: Ash keeps the World title over Chastity after Gothic Angel interferes, and Angela and Lethal Weapon are ruled a draw when both shoulders are shown on the replay to be down. After that match KillSwitch, Gothic Angel and Halloween Jack beat Lone Star down in the ring and write Humanity Crisis in his blood, which is not a match. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Assault, 14 June 2004

date.source: the page repeats the heading of 7 June 2004; the mirror's file is june14 and the CWA schedule of May to July 2004 lists Assault at San Francisco on 14 June 2004

matches.note: Wish wins and rolls out to get away from Vesuvius and Sandman.
Tommy Air wins with a lionsault; BasketKase then attacks him.
Giovanni Mabius wins with some underhanded dealing.
Angela wins.
Halloween Jack pulls Chastity from the ring as Gothic Angel goes for the pin and the bell is rung; Chastity wins by disqualification.
BLC taps out to Halloween Jack's ankle lock.

notes: Two weeks before Sunstroke. Frank Merritt, suspended, applies the Blunt Wrap to Halloween Jack after attacking him and Shelia Lavin tells him he will face Vesuvius at Sunstroke. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Assault, 21 June 2004

date.source: the page's own heading, Assault June 21, 2004; the CWA schedule prints 2003 for this date in error

matches.note: BasketKase wins.
Corina wins her first match with the FF Look.
Chastity wins with a shooting star press and is then attacked by Gothic Angel.
Harmony Fallacia wins.
TJ Mercer pulls off the win.
The referee reaches ten and both are counted out; Kelly then offers Micheal her hand.
KillSwitch wins with a moonsault.

notes: The last Assault before Sunstroke. The Ash and Lethal Weapon steel-cage main event is called off after the two fight backstage, and Shelia and Gloria Lavin announce a new draft for the night of Sunstroke. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.
